applicability: Valid for 1 to 8 integer operands in [-10,20] and exactly len(operands)-1 operators drawn from +,-,*. Rejects malformed inputs, booleans, out-of-range operands, and wrong operator counts. Complexity grows with set sizes but is bounded for the stated limits.
description: Interval dynamic programming over the fixed operand/operator sequence. For each contiguous subinterval of operands, compute the set of all values obtainable by fully parenthesizing that subinterval. Combine sets across every split point using the operator at the split, deduplicating via sets. The answer is the size of the full-interval set. Exact integer arithmetic is used. Uncertainty: assumes the intended semantics is full parenthesization of the fixed sequence (no reordering, no precedence shortcuts), which matches the source framing.
